name: Pandita Ramabai
shortBio: Sanskrit scholar and Indian feminist social reformer whose empirical critique of high-caste Hindu patriarchy, child marriage, and colonial law laid foundations for modern South Asian feminist sociology.
centralQuestion: How do scriptural patriarchy and colonial legal codification intersect to disenfranchise high-caste widows and women across India?

keyWorks.title: The High-Caste Hindu Woman
keyWorks.description: Sociological and ethical indictment of child marriage, enforced widowhood, and systematic denial of female education in colonial India.

keyWorks.title: Stri Dharma Niti (Morals for Women)
keyWorks.description: Marathi treatise urging Indian women toward intellectual self-reliance and moral agency.
